description: GTEx v8 tissue expression profile of UROC1, testing whether the gene is expressed in brain
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}

rows=[]; page=0
while True:
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000159650.8","datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100,"page":page},
        headers=H, timeout=90).json()
    rows += r["data"]
    if page >= r["paging_info"]["numberOfPages"]-1: break
    page+=1
g=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(g.columns.tolist())
g=g.rename(columns={"tissueSiteDetailId":"tissue"})[["tissue","median","unit"]].sort_values("median",ascending=False)
print("n tissues:",len(g))
print(g.head(12).to_string(index=False))
brain=g[g.tissue.str.startswith("Brain")]
print("\nBrain regions n=%d: max %.3f TPM, mean %.3f TPM"%(len(brain),brain["median"].max(),brain["median"].mean()))
tot=g["median"].sum()
print("Liver share of summed median TPM: %.1f%%"%(100*g.loc[g.tissue=="Liver","median"].iloc[0]/tot))
print("Top-4 share: %.1f%%"%(100*g["median"].head(4).sum()/tot))

top=g.head(14).iloc[::-1]
hi={"Liver","Skin_Sun_Exposed_Lower_leg","Skin_Not_Sun_Exposed_Suprapubic","Kidney_Cortex","Kidney_Medulla"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.6))
ax.barh(top.tissue.str.replace("_"," "), top["median"],
        color=["#b4553a" if t in hi else "#5b6b7c" for t in top.tissue])
for i,v in enumerate(top["median"]): ax.text(v+max(top['median'])*0.012,i,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("median TPM, GTEx v8")
ax.set_title("UROC1 expression is confined to liver, skin and kidney\nmean across %d brain regions = %.2f TPM"%(len(brain),brain["median"].mean()))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
